title: Pip Cleans Up the Barn
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing at the entrance of an old wooden barn, looking at golden straw and seed scattered across the floor.
Golden straw and loose seed scattered messily across the floor of an old wooden barn.
Pip the sparrow looking around with a puzzled expression at scattered straw and seed.
Pip the sparrow picking up small bits of golden straw in his beak, one at a time.
Pip the sparrow using his wing to sweep loose seed into a tidy little pile.
Pip the sparrow placing gathered golden straw back into a neat stack in the corner of the barn.
A wide view of a barn, now clean and tidy, golden straw stacked neatly and seed swept into a pile.
Moss the hedgehog arriving at the barn entrance, looking surprised at how clean it is.
Moss the hedgehog talking to Pip the sparrow, both standing in a tidy barn.
Pip the sparrow standing proudly in the middle of a tidy barn, grinning.
